rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for provocative remarks or behaviour intended to provoke a reaction.

example.english: The wording in this editorial is too inflammatory, and it made many people angry.
example.traditional: 呢篇社論用詞挑釁性太強，睇完好多人都嬲。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 se5 leon6 jung6 ci4 tiu1 jan6 sing3 taai3 koeng4 tai2 jyun4 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 nau1

rows.note: Use this instead of 挑釁性 when the remark is specifically intended to stir people up or incite them to act.

example.english: The police said someone had made inflammatory remarks to incite people to storm the government building.
example.traditional: 警方指有人發表煽動性言論，煽動市民衝擊政府大樓。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zi2 jau5 jan4 faat3 biu2 sin3 dung6 sing3 jin4 leon6 sin3 dung6 si5 man4 cung1 gik1 zing3 fu2 daai6 lau4

rows.note: Use this medical term for something relating to, causing, or resulting from inflammation.

example.english: The doctor said this redness and swelling was an inflammatory reaction.
example.traditional: 醫生話呢種紅腫係炎症性反應。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 ne1 zung2 hung4 zung2 hai6 jim4 zing3 sing3 faan2 jing3
